For New York Citys Department of Environmental Protection, Bureau of Police and Security, Aviation Unit. This Competitive Sealed Bid (RFx') is being released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal. Responses to this RFx should be submitted via PASSPort. This will take you to the Public Portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate the RFx, insert the EPIN 82627B0018 into the Keywords search field.
